name: FBR_Boost_ZClamp
rationale: The previous SSHI_FBR designs are 1:1 converters, meaning they cannot boost the piezo voltage above its open-circuit value (V_oc). For S4, V_oc is approx 2.55 V, making it impossible to reach the 4.5 V target. I am replacing the SSHI flipping stage with a DC-DC boost converter. The circuit uses a Full-Bridge Rectifier (FBR) to create a steady DC rail (n_rect), and then a boost stage (L1, S1, D5) to step up this voltage to the required 4.5-5.5 V range. The SYNC controller provides the necessary switching pulses. A Zener clamp (R_clamp, DZ1) is used to prevent overvoltage on S3.
